raid.name: Raid
raid.blurb: Click a tile to walk. Pick a target and it stays picked. Every ability shares a 1.5s global cooldown, and moving cancels a cast — so the whole fight is a question of when you can afford to stand still.

arena.name: Arena
arena.tagline: WASD, mouse aim, no global cooldown.
arena.blurb: Move with WASD and aim with the mouse — there is no target lock, you hit whatever the crosshair is nearest to. Nothing has a cast time and there is no global cooldown, only a 0.3s weapon switch and each weapon's own fire rate. Movement is free; ammo is the thing you run out of.
